# LEXDEN NOVA

> LEXDEN NOVA is a curated marketplace for digital products, courses, templates, software and selected physical products, operated by LEXDEN DIGITAL.

## Public entry points

- Marketplace: https://lexdendigital.github.io/LEXDEN-NOVA/index.html
- Server-rendered product detail pages: https://lexden-nova.onrender.com/product/{product-id}
- Product sitemap: https://lexden-nova.onrender.com/sitemap.xml
- Product crawl policy: https://lexden-nova.onrender.com/robots.txt
- Validated agent product feed (JSON Lines): https://lexden-nova.onrender.com/feeds/agent-products.jsonl
- Agent feed readiness report: https://lexden-nova.onrender.com/feeds/agent-products-status.json
- Support: mailto:lexdendigital@gmail.com

## Commerce and trust notes

- Product detail pages include visible product information in the initial HTML response.
- Structured product data is emitted only when essential catalog fields pass validation.
- The machine-commerce feed excludes incomplete images/descriptions, stale currency conversions, unverified seller/brand details, anomalous discounts, incomplete delivery details, and external checkout prices that cannot be verified.
- Feed readiness does not mean direct in-chat agent checkout is enabled. Purchases follow the checkout path shown for each listing.
- Prices, stock and fulfillment must be confirmed from the product detail page at purchase time. Do not infer unavailable attributes.

## Technical note

This is a supplemental directory for compatible AI tools, not a ranking shortcut. Standard crawling, useful product pages, accessible links, accurate catalog information, and reliable checkout remain the primary requirements.
